title: Temporal trust decay contract (L49)
description: Composite-level exponential decay applied to agent trust. See ADR-037.

invariants.name: multiplicative_composition
invariants.description: composite = composite_raw * decay_factor. Not subtractive, not replacement.
must: code applies decay as `composite = composite_raw * decay_factor`
test verifies multiplicative semantics (not subtraction, not max/min)

invariants.name: half_life_7_days_default
invariants.description: Default half-life pinned at 7 days. Operator-tunable in [1, 90].
must: half_life_days default 7.0
validator accepts range [1.0, 90.0]
outside range -> validation error

invariants.name: exponential_formula
must: formula matches the contract string
implementations using linear or step decay are rejected
decay at age=half_life = 0.5 exactly

invariants.name: never_seen_is_zero
must: agent with no successes returns decay 0.0
composite for never-seen agent is 0.0
router excludes 0.0-decay agents from candidate pool

invariants.name: future_ts_clamps_to_one
must: future timestamps do not yield negative-age math
value clamped at 1.0 (no decay)
logged at DEBUG (not error -- can happen with clock skew across worktrees)

invariants.name: recoverable
invariants.description: First success after staleness resets decay to 1.0.
must: no permanent demotion
recovery is immediate once a fresh success is recorded
decay state is derived from last_success_ts only, no separate 'penalty' state

invariants.name: composes_with_freshness_signal
invariants.description: Per-signal freshness_score (PR #287) continues to exist; THIS decay applies to COMPOSITE.
must: freshness_score still computed and contributed to composite_raw
decay_factor multiplied AFTER the per-signal weighted sum
the two effects are complementary, not redundant
test verifies both fields move independently
